scope: Additive CHI-GB Benjamin St-Juste participation reconciliation. It resolves the prior six-versus-ten public snap-count conflict to ten special-teams snaps through independent source convergence, while preserving the official gamebook's literal return-questionable wording and the remaining source gap for the exact injury play and added-duty successor. It does not calculate a partial loss, mark the pair READY, stage ratings, alter the active manifest or current-week personnel/QB overlays, construct a fair, consult a market, or issue a bet.

sources.finding: The final gamebook identifies St-Juste as an active substitute and records only that his return was questionable after Q3 1:58. It does not record an actual return, exact injury play, special-teams snap total or successor duty.
The October 15 report states that St-Juste played ten special-teams snaps against Chicago and no defensive snaps or recorded statistic.

The current Packers weekly snap table lists St-Juste with ten Week 5 special-teams snaps (42 percent) and explicitly attributes its snap-count data to Pro Football Reference via nflverse. This independently matches the Daily Gopher total. The page also makes clear that it is a derived snap table, not official NFL play-participation evidence.

The roster analysis treats St-Juste as a special-teams ace and says J. Michael Sturdivant could replace those special-teams contributions if St-Juste were unavailable. It is prospective role evidence, not proof that Sturdivant assumed the Week 5 injury-created duty.

stJusteDutyReview.finding: The count conflict is reconciled, but the ten-snap total cannot be used as elapsed-time exposure and does not identify which Week 5 teammate took the injury-created gunner/jammer duty. The prospective Sturdivant role report is insufficient to claim that actual assignment.
missingInformation: An authoritative play-participation record or source-bound last confirmed St-Juste duty before the Q3 1:58 status update
A Week 5 source binding the added gunner/jammer or other special-teams duty to Sturdivant or another exact active identity
stJusteDutyReview.nextAction: Obtain play-participation or role reporting that binds the last confirmed St-Juste special-teams duty and exact successor. Then use the approved bounded exposure and documented-primary or supported-committee method without treating Q3 1:58 as the departure, using snap share as time, or duplicating baseline duties.

blockers.finding: The official final gamebook does not identify St-Juste's injury play or last confirmed special-teams duty. A ten-snap total is now supported, but it is not an elapsed-time interval.
blockers.nextAction: Recover authoritative play participation or a source-bound last-duty timestamp before calculating the partial exposure.

blockers.finding: Sturdivant is documented prospectively as a possible special-teams replacement when St-Juste is unavailable, but no Week 5 source confirms that he or another exact identity assumed the injury-created duty.
blockers.nextAction: Bind the Week 5 successor or a complete supported candidate committee and reserve each added duty once.

blockers.finding: The pair still requires one complete FINAL_GAME_DAY assembly combining every immutable pregame, reserve, partial-game and quarterback case with disjoint cluster coverage.
